sample_unit: questions (25 microbiology, 25 general CF), each answered by three AI platforms

links.outcome: Readability (FRES, FKGL) of AI answers to cystic fibrosis patient questions
links.effect: Microbiology answers: mean FRES 34.30 (Gemini), 25.72 (AI Overview), 19.46 (ChatGPT 4.0); FKGL 11.54, 12.74, 15.10. General CF answers: FKGL 9.52, 9.66, 12.98. Readability did not meet target standards.
links.quote: The readability, however, did not meet the target reference standards and further research is required to ascertain if readability can be improved by using simplification and detailed sentence commands.

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates off-the-shelf LLMs (ChatGPT 4.0, Gemini, Google AI Overview) for readability, accuracy, and completeness when generating patient-facing microbiology and cystic fibrosis health information, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
